notes: IEEE 1516.1-2025 public-API resignation continuation: an owner registers an object and resigns with Unconditionally Divest Attributes while an unrelated observer keeps the execution alive. A later joining federate subscribes and discovers the retained object without an ownership offer. Its later publication makes it assumption-eligible and yields one grouped empty-tag Request Attribute Ownership Assumption callback. Direct pinned native mappings are page-058-l112-33 -> §4.12 and page-059-l8-1 -> §4.12.4. Adapter supplies provider, endpoint, FOM, names, callback model and logical-time implementation. Current-source installed-package C++ primary/contract passed 4/4 under evoked/immediate callbacks. Java parity compiles against the official API-only JAR but has no provider-runtime execution evidence. This is not a conformance claim.
